description: This file contains unit tests for the GstGenericPlayer component, including setup, teardown, and various configuration expectations, using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks.

classes.name: GstGenericPlayerTestCommon
classes.description: A helper class providing methods to set up, configure, and test GstGenericPlayer components in unit tests.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeCreated
methods.description: Sets up expectations for creating and initializing the GstGenericPlayer instance.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeDestroyed
methods.description: Sets up expectations for tearing down the GstGenericPlayer instance.

methods.name: expectShutdown
methods.description: Prepares expectations for shutting down the player, including task creation and thread joining.

methods.name: expectStop
methods.description: Prepares expectations for stopping the player.

methods.name: executeTaskWhenEnqueued
methods.description: Mocks task execution when tasks are enqueued to the worker thread.

methods.name: triggerSetupSource
methods.description: Simulates the source setup callback invocation.

methods.name: triggerSetupElement
methods.description: Simulates the element setup callback invocation.

methods.name: triggerDeepElementAdded
methods.description: Simulates the deep element added callback invocation.

methods.name: setPipelineState
methods.description: Sets the pipeline state for testing.

methods.name: initFactories
methods.description: Initializes mock expectations for factory methods.

methods.name: expectMakePlaybin
methods.description: Sets expectation for creating the playbin element.

methods.name: expectSetFlags
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting play flags.

methods.name: expectSetFlagsWithNativeAudio
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting play flags with native audio support.

methods.name: expectSetSignalCallbacks
methods.description: Sets expectations for connecting GObject signals.

methods.name: expectSetUri
methods.description: Sets expectation for setting the pipeline URI.

methods.name: expectCheckPlaySink
methods.description: Sets expectation for retrieving and configuring the play sink element.

methods.name: expectSetMessageCallback
methods.description: Sets expectation for creating the GStreamer dispatcher thread.
